notes.title: We wins MOST POPULAR VR Game and Qualcomm XR Innovation Challenge SILVER Award!
notes.notes:
Many thanks to the collective votes of our dearest fans, Starway: Baraider has been chosen as the winner of [b]2022 FBEC AND THE 7TH GOLDEN GYRO AWARD: 'MOST POPULAR VR Game' Award[/b]. What's more, we are also awarded [b]2022 Qualcomm XR Innovation Challenge “YVR Innovation Award" Silver Medal![/b]ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105074/753e288f6e12517555bb859525c9827472bc8657.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105074/52422ffdd878d3f88c3c6c83d78ea547eccb757c.png[/img]
Starway: Baraider is a  sci-fi VR shooting action game, which developed by LEIKE.

In LEIKE, we always believe that wonderful experiences have to be created by developers and players together. So we will keep listening to your hearts while developing "Starway".

On behalf of everyone in LEIKE, with endless gratefulness, we want to say thank you to the fans who voted for us and say hello to the Steam community! 

Our EA version and free demo are both coming soon! Hope everyone can enjoy the exciting journey with us!  ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupː
